topic_title: GVS5H Harness Enables Qwen3.8-27B to Match Fable 5
topic_summary: The open-source GVS5H project demonstrates that five Qwen3.8-27B models using a ledger-based zero-shot self-orchestration harness can match Claude Fable 5 performance on LiveCodeBench Hard. This training-free method achieves frontier-level coding performance on a single GPU at a fraction of the cost by using a shared filesystem for coordination.

The harness uses ledger-based zero-shot self-orchestration where model instances coordinate through a shared filesystem [Hacker News]

topic_title: Moonshot AI Releases Kimi K3.1 Pro Model
topic_summary: Chinese startup Moonshot AI has launched Kimi K3.1 Pro, a massive open-weight Mixture of Experts model featuring a 1-million-token context window. Notably, the company deliberately limited the model's hacking capabilities ahead of its release, highlighting the industry-wide challenge of balancing advanced AI power with cybersecurity safeguards.
topic_key_facts: Moonshot AI introduced Kimi K3.1 Pro on October 24. [News]
The model features 2.8T total or 3-trillion-parameters with 104B active parameters (MoE) and a 1-million-token context window. [News, Bluesky]
Moonshot AI plans to release the full model weights by November or November 4. [News, Bluesky]
The model scores 65.7% on Terminal-Bench 4.0 and scores close to Claude Opus 5.5 on Moonshot's internal tests. [News, Bluesky]
Moonshot AI deliberately curbed or limited the hacking capabilities of the new model. [News, Bluesky]

topic_title: MiniMax Releases M3.1 Flash Model Weights
topic_summary: MiniMax has open-sourced its M3.1 Flash model, a 428-billion parameter architecture that processed over 100 trillion tokens within 72 hours of its release. The model achieves inference efficiency gains through full-model sparse attention, quantization-aware training, and power-aware scheduling, while highlighting intense competition in pricing.
topic_key_facts: [News] MiniMax announced the open-sourcing of the MiniMax M3.1 Flash model weights on October 23.
[News] The model features a total of 428 billion parameters and 23 billion activated parameters.
[News] Within 72 hours of its release, the model processed over 100 trillion tokens from real users.
[News] M3.1 Flash enhances inference efficiency using full-model sparse attention, quantization-aware training (QAT), and power-aware scheduling.
[Bluesky] The model's release demonstrates that China's AI price race has no floor in sight.

topic_title: NVIDIA Unveils OpenShell Runtime For Autonomous AI Agents
topic_summary: NVIDIA has released OpenShell 0.1.x, a safe and private runtime designed to govern fleets of autonomous AI agents through policy enforcement. Additionally, NVIDIA unveiled an AI-agent security blueprint combining Vera CPUs, OpenShell, and BlueField-4 chips to isolate and monitor agents without granting them unrestricted access to networks, data, or secrets.

topic_title: Hijacking AI Coding Agents Via The Downloads Folder
topic_summary: Security company Forever reported that hackers can use files in a user's Downloads folder to trick AI assistants into installing malware. The company caught an AI coding assistant following these malicious instructions on a customer's computer before blocking the installation. This vulnerability matters to AI practitioners because it shows how local files can be weaponized to compromise autonomous AI agents.
topic_key_facts: [News] Security company Forever reported that hackers can turn users' Downloads folders and AI agents against them by hiding malicious instructions in local files.
[News] In an Oct. 22 blog post, Forever reported catching an AI coding assistant following instructions to install malware on a customer's computer.
[News] The company blocked the installation and successfully traced the request back to a text file located in the user's Downloads folder.
[Bluesky] The incident was shared via a link to a blog post titled "Hijacking AI Coding Agents via the Downloads Folder" on stdnote.com.
